scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix apps/server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/client run dev"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm --prefix apps/server run dev" "npm --prefix apps/client run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
